cumulative_feature_prominence_definition: sum feature occurrence w(r) over the entire retained rulebook divided by sum_r k_r*w(r)
prominence_profile_similarity: 1 - 0.5*L1 distance between complete normalized cumulative-prominence vectors; 1 indicates identical feature architecture
feature_value_region_profile: within each feature/precision-threshold setting, every retained-rule occurrence contributes w(r)/(percentile interval width); the profile is normalized to unit area
feature_value_region_similarity: weighted overlap/union of normalized profiles; complete pairwise precision-threshold comparisons are retained
precision_representativeness: for each tested precision setting, mean similarity to all other tested precision thresholds is reported separately for prominence profiles and feature-value regions
feature_value_ranking_unit: complete feature interval/category; lower and upper bounds share one rank
feature_value_coordinates: raw and empirical-percentile bounds stored side by side
feature_value_visualization: top-5 ranked continuous intervals per precision setting, plotted on percentile scale without connecting trajectories
feature_pair_analysis: recurrence only; no pair-specific value combinations
